experiences.title: Webcloster
description: Optimized web performance by implementing strategic lazy loading and cache control, achieving tangible improvements in metrics such as LCP and CLS.
Resolved SVG compatibility issues with professional software (CorelDRAW) by developing an export system with relative paths and automated ZIP packaging.

Developed modular interfaces in Angular with protected route systems using guards, implementing a dynamic and configurable template loader, decoupled logic, and a scalable structure for persistent configuration management via JSON and image file loading/saving.
Implemented a decoupled backend using Slim PHP and Mustache, with a secure JWT-based authentication system, structuring efficient endpoints with clean views and simple integration.
